name: A Never Ending Cycle
source:
A visual novel inspired by the DarkErrorcore aesthetic, this is a story about no longer feeling like oneself.

The feeling of feeling alone in a world that sees you as something different.

Where being "too different" is seen at something undesirable.

The fear of not fitting in and everyone seeing through your façade.

Of never living up to society's standards and what is considered "normal". 

How do you perceive yourself, when all you've ever learnt that everything about yourself is considered bad?

[From [url=https://imwithredshirt.itch.io/a-never-ending-cycle]itch.io[/url]]
